description.p: Vaultime tracks how long you play your PC games, across launchers and standalone games. It keeps runtime, active playtime and idle time apart and stores every session on your PC in a hash-linked log that shows changes made outside Vaultime.

ul.li: Detects when games in your library run and records sessions
Finds games from Steam, Xbox, Epic, GOG, EA and other launchers, and scans common game folders
Shows your library with artwork from your game folders, framed the way you like
Dark and light looks with ground tones, accent colors and a background picture
Local backups, plus optional encrypted backup to an invite-only server
